summary: Field Status feature testing completed successfully. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with Field Status section, +/- buttons, Full Load/Partial Load alerts, progress bar, and auto-decrement on collection.
passed_tests: Navigate to Field page (/field) via nav-field
Field Status section visible at top with 'Field Status' heading
Per-colour ready counts shown (Green, Orange, Yellow) with +/- buttons
Clicking + increments ready count (persists via PUT /api/field-status)
Total Ready bar shows sum of all colour ready counts
Full Load alert (data-testid: full-load-alert) appears when total >= 10
Partial Load alert (data-testid: partial-load-alert) appears when 0 < total < 10
Progress bar fills green at >= 10, amber near 7-9
PUT /api/field-status updates a colour's ready count (upsert)
Field collection (collect to yard) auto-decrements field status counts
Collect to Yard section works (add pallets, submit collection)
Recent Field Collections history displays correctly
Authentication required for field-status endpoints (401 without token)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing colours (green, orange, yellow)
